premises.text: Plastic gift cards are lost, stolen, or forgotten, leaving large unspent balances that hurt consumers and retailers
premises.evidence_span: your gift cards end up lost, stolen, or forgotten

premises.text: A mobile app stores gift cards in the cloud by entering merchant and card codes with balance verification
premises.evidence_span: My cards are now securely backed up in the cloud

premises.text: Users can buy and send personalized gift cards via Facebook, email, or text with merchant suggestions and event reminders
premises.evidence_span: Gift is seamlessly integrated with Facebook for convenience around sending gift cards to friends and family

premises.text: In-store redemption uses barcode/numeric display including a patented scratch-to-reveal code
premises.evidence_span: Redemption is simple, with both barcode and numeric options

premises.text: Unwanted cards can be regifted to friends from the app
premises.evidence_span: you can regift unwanted cards to your friends

premises.text: Open APIs will let retailers push cards into the wallet and developers build on the platform
premises.evidence_span: enabling both retailers and developers to leverage our open APIs

premises.text: Launch distribution includes a large set of national retail partners as a mobile gift-card store
premises.evidence_span: we've secured over 200 national retail partners to launch with our app

value.text: Make gift cards fun, social, and usable from a phone so they are not lost or unused
value.evidence_span: We're making gift cards fun, and we're making gift cards social

notes: Lost/stolen/forgotten unspent cards folded as one problem (§4.1.6). Upload, send, redeem, scratch, and regift treated as distinct jobs within the wallet product under enumeration rule 2, grouped in one revisable wallet domain. Funding and free-card giveaways excluded (§4.2). Three domains—anti-template: retailer API/partner distribution separately revisable from consumer wallet UX.
